name: Local Dictation: Private Voice
subtitle: On-device speech to text
availability: 174 countries or regions excluding France; available on app release, not currently published
promotionalText: Private dictation for your Mac. Transcribe and clean up speech on your device, then insert it into supported editors through macOS Services.
description:
Turn your voice into text on your Mac. Local Dictation runs speech recognition and text cleanup on your device, with no account, API key, or cloud transcription fallback.

DICTATE INTO SUPPORTED EDITORS
Click a text field, then choose Services > Dictate with Local Dictation from the app's menu. Speak in the recording window and choose Stop & Insert. You can assign a Services keyboard shortcut in System Settings. Editors that support macOS text Services can receive the result directly; in other apps, record in Local Dictation and use Copy.

CHOOSE YOUR RESULT
Use Clean up wording for fillers, repetition, and clear spoken corrections, or Original transcript to keep the speech recognizer's wording. You can review and edit a transcript before copying it.

YOUR MAC DOES THE PROCESSING
Record for up to five minutes. Choose your microphone in the app. Audio stays in memory, and no transcript history is saved. Text you place in another app follows that app's privacy practices.

FIRST-TIME SETUP
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or newer. Initial setup downloads about 3.4 GB of local models; keep 8 GB free. After setup, dictation can run offline. English is the supported language. Names, numbers, and ambiguous speech may still need editing.
reviewNotes:
This is the sandboxed macOS Services edition. It does not use the website edition's Fn shortcut, Accessibility API, installer, or global keyboard event tap.

No sign-in is required. Open the app and choose Download models for about 3.4 GB of verified weights. Speech and cleanup run locally using bundled sandbox-inheriting helpers. The cleanup server binds only to loopback.

Once setup is ready, click a text field in a Services-compatible editor such as TextEdit, choose Services > Dictate with Local Dictation from that editor's application menu, allow microphone access, speak, and choose Stop & Insert. For editors without text Services support, use the recording window and Copy.

Services has a bounded timeout and returns no text after cancellation. Model downloads contain data only; the app never downloads executable code. Full first-run and editor acceptance checks must be completed before submitting this candidate.

sandboxUsage.com.apple.security.network.client: Downloads the pinned speech and cleanup model weights over HTTPS after the user chooses Download models. URLs are sealed in the app manifest; downloads must match the exact size and SHA-256 before use. The app also makes requests to its bundled cleanup helper on 127.0.0.1:11439. Voice audio and transcripts are not sent to an external service.
sandboxUsage.com.apple.security.device.audio-input: Captures microphone audio only after the user starts dictation or the five-second Test microphone action, and after macOS grants microphone permission. Speech recognition and optional wording cleanup run on this Mac. The microphone test is not transcribed; audio stays in memory and is discarded after the operation.
sandboxUsage.com.apple.security.network.server: The sealed Ollama helper inherits the app sandbox and listens only on 127.0.0.1:11439 so the app can request on-device wording cleanup. The server is not exposed on a LAN or public interface. The app starts and stops this bundled helper; downloaded model files are data and no executable code is downloaded.
